title: E2E: fresh-install suite
description: A Playwright project that starts from an empty database and proves the sprint's promise end to end, using saved BHPLTA pages rather than the live site. This suite becomes a required CI job in Sprint 022.

recommended_model.name: Sonnet 5.5
recommended_model.rationale: Test authoring against a specified flow.

acceptance_criteria: New Playwright project 'fresh-install' runs against an empty volume
Covers: setup code gate, administrator creation, club selection, BHPLTA bootstrap from saved pages, settings change, player link generation, dashboard reachable
Asserts setup is unreachable afterwards and that no account exists other than the created administrator
make test-e2e-fresh target added; existing suites still pass

files_to_modify: CLAUDE.md (test counts are stale: 28 spec files today)
notes: The scraper needs a base-URL override so tests can point it at a local fixture server.

testing_requirements: The suite itself, run twice in a row to prove it is repeatable

context.user_story: As the maintainer, I want an automated proof that a new club can get from nothing to working.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
